title: Functional-Safety-Integrity Degradation of Student-Built Emergency-Stop Circuits in Engineering Technology Education Workshops: A Fault-Injection Evaluation Linking Relay Contact Welding to Operator Injury-Risk Exposure
authors: Akosua Serwaa Adjei-Boateng, Esi Kwasi Yeboah, Kwabena Ofori-Atta
abstract: Emergency-stop circuits built by engineering technology students are routinely treated as safe once they pass a functional test at commissioning, yet the relay contact welding that dominates their failure modes is invisible to such tests and accumulates silently across the workshop's operating life. The framework represents a student-built circuit as a series safety function whose integrity is degraded by contact welding, and derives the conditions under which a welded contact converts a demanded stop into an undetected loss of safety function. A replication-based evaluation of the before-after-control-impact estimator was conducted under a declared variance structure with a between-cluster standard deviation of 6.0, a residual standard deviation of 4.5 and an intraclass correlation of 0.64, across 2000 replications per design cell for cluster counts of 8, 16, 24 and 32 and effect sizes of 3, 5 and 8 percentage points. The evaluation indicates that 54 clusters are required to detect a 5-percentage-point effect at 80% power, and that the minimum detectable effect at 80% power falls as the number of clusters rises. The framework proposes that workshop safety assurance should shift from commissioning-time functional testing to integrity monitoring that is sensitive to contact welding, and the design analysis implies that cluster-level evaluations of such interventions require cluster counts well above those typical of single-institution studies.
venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

infographic.key_insight: Relay contact welding can silently compromise student-built emergency-stop circuits despite successful commissioning tests.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Workshop safety assurance should include monitoring sensitive to welded contacts rather than rely solely on initial functional testing.
method: Model the circuit as a series safety function degraded by contact welding.
Identify conditions where welded contacts cause an undetected failure to stop.
Simulate before-after-control-impact evaluations across cluster counts and effect sizes.

zh-Hans.title: 工程技术教育实训车间中学生搭建的急停电路的功能安全完整性退化：关联继电器触点熔焊与操作人员伤害风险暴露的故障注入评估
zh-Hans.abstract: 工程技术专业学生搭建的急停电路通常在调试时通过功能测试后就被视为安全，但在其失效模式中占主导地位的继电器触点熔焊无法通过此类测试察觉，并会在实训车间的整个运行寿命期间悄然累积。该框架将学生搭建的电路表示为完整性因触点熔焊而退化的串联安全功能，并推导出熔焊触点使停机请求转变为未被检测到的安全功能丧失的条件。在明确设定的方差结构下，对前后-对照-影响估计量进行了基于重复模拟的评估，其中簇间标准差为6.0、残差标准差为4.5、组内相关系数为0.64；簇数分别为8、16、24和32，效应量分别为3、5和8个百分点，每个设计单元进行2000次重复模拟。评估表明，以80%的统计功效检出5个百分点的效应需要54个簇，且在80%统计功效下，最小可检测效应随簇数增加而减小。该框架提出，实训车间的安全保障应从调试阶段的功能测试转向能够灵敏识别触点熔焊的完整性监测；设计分析则表明，对此类干预措施进行簇级评估所需的簇数远高于单一院校研究的通常水平。

infographic.key_insight: 即使调试测试顺利通过，继电器触点熔焊仍可能悄然损害学生搭建的急停电路的安全性。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 实训车间的安全保障应包括能够灵敏识别触点熔焊的监测，而非仅依赖初始功能测试。
method: 将电路建模为因触点熔焊而退化的串联安全功能。
确定熔焊触点导致未被检测到的停机失效的条件。
针对不同簇数和效应量，模拟前后-对照-影响评估。
infographic.evidence_signal: 该分析在每个设计单元进行2,000次重复模拟，估计以80%的统计功效检出5个百分点的效应需要54个簇。

title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene
authors: A. Alhourani, I. Barsoum, J. Sheikh-Ahmad, S. Deveci
abstract: Friction stir welding (FSW) has gained recognition as an effective technique for joining thermoplastic materials. This study presents a comprehensive investigation to predict FSW characteristics such as weld temperatures, vertical axial forces, material flow and defect formation in FSW of high-density polyethylene (HDPE) using both computational and machine learning approaches, validated by experimental results. A three-dimensional Coupled Eulerian-Lagrangian (CEL) numerical model is developed to simulate the HDPE welding process under varying process parameters of rotational and welding speeds, and bottom preheating conditions. The CEL numerical model is validated against experimental data, showing markedly good agreement in predicting void formation, thermal and mechanical responses. Results indicate that preheating the bottom surface proved effective in reducing thermal gradients and stabilizing vertical force fluctuations. Quantitatively, bottom-surface preheating at 60 °C reduced peak plunge force from 1600 N close to 1100 N and raised peak temperatures from 70 °C (without preheat) to about 100 °C, hence smoothing through-thickness gradients and stabilizing the axial force distribution. In parallel, two multilayer perceptron artificial neural networks (ANNs) are trained on experimental data to predict temporal temperature and axial force responses with R2 between 0.91 and 0.99, demonstrating high accuracy and strong generalization across the tested FSW parameter space. The computational CEL simulations accurately predicted weld zone morphology, including stir zone, thermo-mechanically affected zone and heat-affected zone, however the combined CEL–ANN framework enables rapid generation of process maps that highlights defective and defect-free welding windows, with optimal conditions obtained at 1500 rpm and 30 mm/min with 60 °C preheating, and poor weldability observed at 1000 rpm without preheating due to wormhole formation. These findings provide process-driven design guidelines for developing robust HDPE joints and demonstrate how integrating computational modeling with machine learning enables efficient optimization, offering valuable insights into the key characteristics of the FSW process in thermoplastics and supporting its broader adoption in industrial applications.

infographic.key_insight: Combining physics-based simulation with neural networks identified an optimal tested HDPE friction stir welding condition of 1500 rpm, 30 mm/min and 60 °C bottom preheating.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The framework supports weld-process selection to reduce void defects, moderate thermal gradients and stabilize axial forces in HDPE joints.
method: Model welding temperature, force, material flow and defects using a 3D Coupled Eulerian–Lagrangian simulation.
Train two multilayer perceptron neural networks on experimental temperature and axial-force histories.
Combine simulation and ANN predictions to map defective and defect-free processing windows.
infographic.evidence_signal: Experimentally validated simulations captured weld morphology and responses; ANNs achieved R² of 0.91–0.99, while 60 °C preheating reduced peak plunge force from 1600 N to approximately 1100 N.
infographic.watch_item: Predictive accuracy and the reported optimum are established within the tested parameter space; other geometries, HDPE grades or operating conditions require validation.
infographic.paper_title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene

zh-Hans.title: 用于预测高密度聚乙烯搅拌摩擦焊焊接质量的计算建模与机器学习建模方法
zh-Hans.abstract: 搅拌摩擦焊（FSW）已被认可为连接热塑性材料的一种有效技术。本研究结合计算方法与机器学习方法，对高密度聚乙烯（HDPE）搅拌摩擦焊中的焊接温度、垂直轴向力、材料流动和缺陷形成等特征进行全面预测研究，并通过实验结果进行验证。研究建立了三维耦合欧拉–拉格朗日（CEL）数值模型，用于模拟不同转速、焊接速度和底面预热条件下的HDPE焊接过程。CEL数值模型经实验数据验证，在预测孔洞形成以及热响应和力学响应方面表现出良好的一致性。结果表明，底面预热可有效减小温度梯度并稳定垂直力波动。定量而言，60 °C底面预热使峰值下压力从1600 N降至接近1100 N，并使峰值温度从70 °C（无预热）升至约100 °C，从而减小厚度方向的温度梯度并稳定轴向力分布。与此同时，利用实验数据训练了两个多层感知机人工神经网络（ANN），用于预测温度和轴向力随时间的响应，R2介于0.91与0.99之间，表明其在所测试的FSW参数空间内具有较高的精度和较强的泛化能力。CEL计算模拟准确预测了焊接区域的形貌，包括搅拌区、热机械影响区和热影响区；而CEL–ANN联合框架则能够快速生成工艺图，标示出存在缺陷和无缺陷的焊接工艺窗口。在所测试条件下，1500 rpm、30 mm/min并配合60 °C预热时获得了最佳条件，而在1000 rpm且无预热时，由于形成虫洞缺陷，观察到较差的可焊性。这些发现为制备可靠的HDPE接头提供了以工艺为导向的设计指南，并展示了如何通过整合计算建模与机器学习实现高效优化，为理解热塑性材料FSW过程的关键特征提供了有价值的见解，同时支持该技术在工业应用中的更广泛采用。

infographic.key_insight: 结合基于物理的模拟与神经网络，确定了所测试HDPE搅拌摩擦焊条件中的最佳组合：1500 rpm、30 mm/min和60 °C底面预热。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该框架支持焊接工艺选择，以减少HDPE接头中的孔洞缺陷、减小温度梯度并稳定轴向力。
method: 使用三维耦合欧拉–拉格朗日模拟，对焊接温度、力、材料流动和缺陷进行建模。
利用实验测得的温度和轴向力时间历程训练两个多层感知机神经网络。
结合模拟与ANN预测，绘制存在缺陷和无缺陷的工艺窗口图。
infographic.evidence_signal: 经实验验证的模拟捕捉了焊接区域的形貌和响应；ANN的R²达到0.91–0.99，而60 °C预热使峰值下压力从1600 N降至约1100 N。
infographic.watch_item: 预测精度和所报告的最佳条件均在所测试的参数空间内得到确认；其他几何形状、HDPE牌号或操作条件仍需验证。

title: Effect of spray distance in D-gun sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr coatings on DSS 2205 in acidic environments
authors: Roshan Kuruvila, Mebin T Kuruvila, Manu Harilal, S. Thirumalai Kumaran
abstract: Cermet coating, which is a blend of ceramic hardness and metallic toughness, is mostly applied to enhance the wear and corrosion resistance of metals. Detonation gun ( D -gun) spraying is one of the most promising thermal spray technologies that would produce a high-quality ceramic coating. Cr 3 C 2 -NiCr coating is acceptable because of its superior mechanical characteristics and corrosion characteristic. The effectiveness of D -gun sprayed Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings was evaluated under aggressive acidic conditions using 1 M H₂SO₄, which serves as a standardized laboratory electrolyte for assessing corrosion resistance relevant to industrial acidic environments, including the key process variables such as spraying distance, which is critically important in the determination of other coating properties such as porosity, adhesion, roughness, and hardness. Duplex stainless steel (DSS) 2205 has been sprayed with Cr 3 C 2 -NiCr at three spraying distances; 170 mm, 180 mm and 190 mm in an attempt to conduct the research on the behavior of Cr 3 C 2 -NiCr in acid conditions. Electrochemical activity of the coating was evaluated in 1 M H 2 SO 4 solutions at room temperature; by open circuit potential (OCP), electrochemical impedance spectroscopy and potentiodynamic polarisation. Investigation of surface morphology under SEM revealed dense lamellar coatings with porosity decreasing from 2.84% at 170 mm to 1.38% at 190 mm, indicating improved particle melting and coating compactness. The coating deposited at 190 mm exhibited the best electrochemical performance, with lowest corrosion rate (0.113 mmpy), compared with the uncoated substrate (2.60 mmpy). All coated specimens had a homogenous and compact coating structure. The results demonstrate that 190 mm is the optimum spray distance for producing high-integrity Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings on DSS 2205, providing enhanced corrosion protection for components operating in aggressive acidic industrial environments. This work demonstrates that optimizing the D -gun spray distance significantly influences the microstructural integrity and electrochemical corrosion behaviour of Cr₃C₂–25NiCr coatings on DSS 2205. The established processing–microstructure–performance relationship provides a scientific basis for optimizing D -gun coating parameters to enhance corrosion resistance in aggressive acidic environments.

infographic.key_insight: Among the three spray distances tested, 190 mm produced the lowest-porosity Cr₃C₂–NiCr coating and the best corrosion resistance on DSS 2205.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Optimizing D-gun spray distance can improve coating integrity and corrosion protection for DSS 2205 components exposed to acidic environments.
method: D-gun spray Cr₃C₂–NiCr onto DSS 2205 at 170, 180 and 190 mm.
Examine coating morphology and porosity using SEM.
Evaluate corrosion in room-temperature 1 M H₂SO₄ using OCP, impedance spectroscopy and potentiodynamic polarization.
infographic.evidence_signal: Porosity decreased from 2.84% at 170 mm to 1.38% at 190 mm; the 190 mm coating had a corrosion rate of 0.113 mm/year versus 2.60 mm/year for uncoated DSS 2205.
infographic.watch_item: The reported optimum applies to the tested distances and laboratory electrolyte; performance under industrial temperatures, flow and long-term exposure requires validation.
infographic.paper_title: Effect of spray distance in D-gun sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr coatings on DSS 2205 in acidic environments

zh-Hans.title: 喷涂距离对酸性环境中DSS 2205表面D-gun喷涂Cr3C2–NiCr涂层的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 金属陶瓷涂层兼具陶瓷的硬度和金属的韧性，主要用于提高金属的耐磨性和耐腐蚀性。爆炸喷涂（D-gun）是最具前景的热喷涂技术之一，可制备高质量的陶瓷涂层。Cr3C2–NiCr涂层因其优异的力学特性和耐腐蚀特性而适用。本研究采用1 M H₂SO₄，在强腐蚀性酸性条件下评估D-gun喷涂Cr₃C₂–NiCr涂层的性能；该溶液作为标准化实验室电解液，用于评估与工业酸性环境相关的耐腐蚀性。研究涵盖喷涂距离等关键工艺变量，喷涂距离对孔隙率、附着力、粗糙度和硬度等其他涂层性能具有至关重要的影响。为研究Cr3C2–NiCr在酸性条件下的行为，在双相不锈钢（DSS）2205表面分别以170 mm、180 mm和190 mm三种喷涂距离喷涂Cr3C2–NiCr。通过开路电位（OCP）、电化学阻抗谱和动电位极化，在室温下的1 M H₂SO₄溶液中评估涂层的电化学活性。扫描电子显微镜（SEM）表面形貌观察显示，涂层呈致密层片状结构，孔隙率从170 mm时的2.84%降至190 mm时的1.38%，表明颗粒熔化程度和涂层致密性有所改善。在190 mm喷涂距离下沉积的涂层表现出最佳的电化学性能，其腐蚀速率最低，为0.113 mmpy，而未涂覆基体的腐蚀速率为2.60 mmpy。所有涂覆试样均具有均匀、致密的涂层结构。结果表明，190 mm是在DSS 2205表面制备高完整性Cr₃C₂–NiCr涂层的最佳喷涂距离，可为在强腐蚀性工业酸性环境中运行的部件提供更好的腐蚀防护。本研究表明，优化D-gun喷涂距离会显著影响DSS 2205表面Cr₃C₂–25NiCr涂层的微观结构完整性和电化学腐蚀行为。所建立的工艺–微观结构–性能关系，为优化D-gun涂层工艺参数以提高强腐蚀性酸性环境中的耐腐蚀性提供了科学依据。

infographic.key_insight: 在所测试的三种喷涂距离中，190 mm在DSS 2205表面制备的Cr₃C₂–NiCr涂层孔隙率最低，耐腐蚀性最佳。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 优化D-gun喷涂距离可提高涂层完整性，并改善暴露于酸性环境中的DSS 2205部件的腐蚀防护性能。
method: 采用D-gun，以170、180和190 mm的喷涂距离在DSS 2205表面喷涂Cr₃C₂–NiCr。
使用SEM观察涂层形貌并测定孔隙率。
采用OCP、阻抗谱和动电位极化，在室温下的1 M H₂SO₄中评估腐蚀行为。
infographic.evidence_signal: 孔隙率从170 mm时的2.84%降至190 mm时的1.38%；190 mm喷涂距离下制备的涂层腐蚀速率为0.113 mm/年，而未涂覆DSS 2205的腐蚀速率为2.60 mm/年。
infographic.watch_item: 所报告的最佳喷涂距离适用于已测试的距离和实验室电解液；在工业温度、流动及长期暴露条件下的性能仍需验证。

title: High-resolution topology-preserving instance segmentation network for vision-based measurement system of dense welding material stubs
authors: Xinyu Chen, YuChao Chen, Yan Ren, Guangming Lv, Meng Zhang, Wang Yuan
abstract: Abstract Accurate counting and morphological analysis of welding electrodes and wire stubs are essential for warehouse data management in welding factories. However, the visual recognition of welding material stubs in real-world industrial applications is frequently hindered by issues such as missed detections, false detections, and imprecise boundary localization. To address these metrological and visual perception challenges, this paper proposes a novel High-resolution Topology-Preserving Instance Segmentation Network (HTP-Net). The proposed end-to-end architecture seamlessly integrates three core designs to realize precise decoupling and robust counting of dense targets.Specifically, a Wavelet-Driven Edge-Preserving (WEP) module is designed to retain subtle physical boundaries without loss during feature downsampling. Concurrently, a Long-Range Topology Representation Block (LTR-Block) mitigates topological disconnections resulting from extreme target slenderness by global context modeling. Finally, an Orientation-Driven Instance Segmentation Head (ODI-Seg) leverages rotational geometric priors to fundamentally resolve excessive NMS and overlapping mask artifacts. Notably, across both our custom and public datasets of dense slender materials, HTP-Net achieves substantial performance gains over existing methods, improving mAP 50 scores by at least 1.2% and up to 55.3%. Furthermore, we developed an intelligent counting system for welding materials powered by the proposed model, which has been deployed and validated in a real-world factory environment. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the integrated system achieves average recognition accuracies of 99% and 94% for electrode and wire stubs, respectively.

infographic.key_insight: HTP-Net improves segmentation and counting of dense, slender welding material stubs by preserving boundaries, maintaining topological continuity, and separating overlapping instances.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The model supports automated inventory counting and morphological analysis of electrode and wire stubs in welding factories.
method: Wavelet-driven edge preservation retains fine boundaries during downsampling.
Long-range topology modeling reduces disconnections in slender targets.
Orientation-guided segmentation uses rotational priors to reduce excessive non-maximum suppression and overlapping-mask artifacts.
infographic.evidence_signal: On custom and public datasets, the abstract reports mAP50 gains of 1.2%–55.3% over existing methods; a factory-deployed system achieved average recognition accuracies of 99% for electrode stubs and 94% for wire stubs.
infographic.watch_item: The abstract does not specify dataset sizes, inference speed, or robustness across factory lighting and camera setups, so deployment generalizability needs verification.
infographic.paper_title: High-resolution topology-preserving instance segmentation network for vision-based measurement system of dense welding material stubs

zh-Hans.title: 用于密集焊接材料残段视觉测量系统的高分辨率拓扑保持实例分割网络
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 焊条和焊丝残段的准确计数与形态分析对焊接工厂的仓储数据管理至关重要。然而，在实际工业应用中，焊接材料残段的视觉识别经常受到漏检、误检和边界定位不精确等问题的影响。为应对这些计量与视觉感知挑战，本文提出了一种新型高分辨率拓扑保持实例分割网络（HTP-Net）。所提出的端到端架构无缝集成了三项核心设计，以实现密集目标的精确解耦与稳健计数。具体而言，设计了小波驱动的边缘保持（WEP）模块，以在特征下采样过程中无损保留细微的物理边界。同时，长程拓扑表示块（LTR-Block）通过全局上下文建模，缓解目标极度细长所导致的拓扑断连问题。最后，方向驱动的实例分割头（ODI-Seg）利用旋转几何先验，从根本上解决过度非极大值抑制（NMS）和掩膜重叠伪影问题。值得注意的是，在我们的自建及公开密集细长材料数据集上，HTP-Net 相较于现有方法取得了显著的性能提升，mAP 50 得分至少提高了 1.2%，最高提高了 55.3%。此外，我们基于所提出的模型开发了一套焊接材料智能计数系统，并已在实际工厂环境中部署和验证。大量实验表明，该集成系统对焊条残段和焊丝残段的平均识别准确率分别达到 99% 和 94%。

infographic.key_insight: HTP-Net 通过保留边界、维持拓扑连续性以及分离重叠实例，改善了密集细长焊接材料残段的分割与计数效果。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该模型支持焊接工厂中焊条和焊丝残段的自动化库存计数与形态分析。
method: 小波驱动的边缘保持机制在下采样过程中保留精细边界。
长程拓扑建模减少细长目标中的断连。
方向引导的分割利用旋转先验，减少过度非极大值抑制和掩膜重叠伪影。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告称，在自建和公开数据集上，相较于现有方法，mAP50 提高了 1.2%–55.3%；部署于工厂的系统对焊条残段和焊丝残段的平均识别准确率分别达到 99% 和 94%。
infographic.watch_item: 摘要未说明数据集规模、推理速度，或在不同工厂照明条件和相机配置下的稳健性，因此其部署泛化能力仍需验证。

title: Causal discovery of signal morphology drivers in steel resistance spot welding: a high-dimensional data analysis
authors: Hendrik Schulz, M. Stender
abstract: Abstract Resistance spot welding is a primary joining technique in the automotive and general metal manufacturing industries due to its cost-efficiency and potential for automation. As manufacturing transitions to Industry 4.0, an unprecedented volume of high-frequency process data is recorded. Recent advances rely on machine learning to correlate process data with weld quality. However, existing correlational models are typically trained under restricted laboratory conditions, lacking both physical interpretability and generalization across heterogeneous stack-up configurations with varying materials, coatings, thicknesses, and electrode guns. Here we show that by applying a two-phase causal discovery framework and time series clustering to 15,096 representative profiles derived from over 1.8 million welds, one can extract the structural dependencies of signal morphology from multicollinear stack-up configurations. Increased alloying content is associated with accelerated localized heating, advancing dynamic resistance peaks and suppressing secondary peaks in press-hardened steel. Sheet thickness proportionally scales dynamic resistance, displacement, and force amplitudes, while serving as a primary indicator for post-expansion stability. Reducing tip face diameter from 8 to 6 mm increases the initial resistance peak by 9 % and alters post-expansion mechanics. Finally, at a constant thickness, internal faying surface quantity remains statistically insignificant to macroscopic resistance.

infographic.key_insight: Causal discovery links steel composition, sheet thickness, and electrode tip diameter to distinct resistance spot-welding signal features, improving physical interpretability beyond correlation alone.
infographic.engineering_relevance: These relationships can inform interpretable weld monitoring and process adjustment across heterogeneous material stacks and electrode configurations.
method: Apply a two-phase causal discovery framework to multicollinear stack-up configurations.
Cluster time series to characterize process-signal morphology.
Analyze how material and geometric factors relate to resistance, displacement, and force signals.
infographic.evidence_signal: Analysis of 15,096 representative profiles derived from over 1.8 million welds found that reducing tip face diameter from 8 to 6 mm increased the initial resistance peak by 9%.
infographic.watch_item: Discovered dependencies do not by themselves establish that process adjustments will improve weld quality; intervention-based validation remains important.
infographic.paper_title: Causal discovery of signal morphology drivers in steel resistance spot welding: a high-dimensional data analysis

zh-Hans.title: 钢材电阻点焊中信号形态驱动因素的因果发现：高维数据分析
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 电阻点焊因其成本效益和自动化潜力，成为汽车及通用金属制造行业的主要连接技术。随着制造业向工业4.0转型，所记录的高频过程数据量达到前所未有的规模。近期研究进展依靠机器学习建立过程数据与焊点质量之间的相关关系。然而，现有相关性模型通常在受限的实验室条件下训练，既缺乏物理可解释性，也缺乏在材料、涂层、厚度和焊枪各异的异质叠层配置之间的泛化能力。本研究表明，通过对从超过180万次焊接中提取的15,096条代表性曲线应用两阶段因果发现框架和时间序列聚类，可以从具有多重共线性的叠层配置中提取信号形态的结构依赖关系。合金元素含量增加与局部加热加速相关，使热冲压硬化钢的动态电阻峰提前出现，并抑制次级峰。板材厚度使动态电阻、位移和力的幅值按比例变化，同时也是膨胀后稳定性的主要指示因素。将电极端面直径从8 mm减小至6 mm，会使初始电阻峰值增加9%，并改变膨胀后的力学行为。最后，在厚度恒定时，内部贴合界面数量对宏观电阻的影响仍不具有统计显著性。

infographic.key_insight: 因果发现将钢材成分、板材厚度和电极端面直径与不同的电阻点焊信号特征联系起来，提供了超越单纯相关性分析的物理可解释性。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这些关系可为异质材料叠层和电极配置下的可解释焊接监测与工艺调整提供依据。
method: 对具有多重共线性的叠层配置应用两阶段因果发现框架。
对时间序列进行聚类，以表征过程信号形态。
分析材料和几何因素与电阻、位移及力信号之间的关系。
infographic.evidence_signal: 对从超过180万次焊接中提取的15,096条代表性曲线的分析发现，将电极端面直径从8 mm减小至6 mm，会使初始电阻峰值增加9%。
infographic.watch_item: 所发现的依赖关系本身并不能证明工艺调整会改善焊点质量；基于干预的验证仍然重要。

title: Microstructure, Wear and Corrosion Resistances of Atmospheric Plasma, Detonation, High Velocity Oxy-fuel and High Velocity Air-fuel Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Cemented Carbide Coatings
authors: Ting XIA, Yueming WANG, Lu XIE
abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr cemented carbide coating has the advantages of superior wear property and corrosion resistance. WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were prepared on 304 stainless steel substrates by different thermal spray technologies including atmospheric plasma spraying (APS), detonation spraying (DS), high velocity oxy-fuel spraying (HVOFS), and high velocity air-fuel spraying (HVAFS), respectively. The microstructure, tribological properties and corrosion resistances of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were systematically investigated and compared. The results showed that the Vickers hardness of cemented coatings prepared by APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF, which were all higher than those of 304 stainless steel, were 771.4 HV, 954.2 HV, 1166.2 HV, and 1162.2 HV, respectively. The volume wear rate of 304 stainless steel was about (36.82±0.80)×10-5 mm3/N·m. The volume wear rates of APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF coatings, which were all lower than that of 304 stainless steel, were about (7.93±0.30)×10-5, (1.51±0.20)×10-5, (1.17±0.10)×10-5, and (1.10±0.01)×10-5 mm3/N·m, respectively. In addition, the average friction coefficients of 304 stainless steel substrate, APS coating, DS one, HVOF one and HVAF one were about (0.68±0.03), (0.56±0.02), (0.48±0.01), (0.44±0.01) and (0.43±0.01), respectively. Spalling, microcracks perpendicular to the friction direction, and grooves parallel to the friction direction can be found in the wear marks of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings. Abrasive wear and fatigue wear are the main wear mechanisms of the cemented coatings. During the wear test, the carbide particles in DS, HVOF and HVAF coatings gradually became the main body bearing the friction load. Then the wear resistance of the latter three coatings was all superior to that of APS. Moreover, HVOF and HVAF coatings have better wear performances. For corrosion resistance from high to low were HVAF coating, DS one, HVOF one and APS one, respectively. The HVAF coating demonstrated the highest corrosion potential (-0.37±0.01 VSCE), smallest corrosion current density (1.75±0.02 μA/cm²), and largest corrosion resistance (20438.5 Ω) here. The APS coating had the poorest corrosion resistance among these four coatings.

infographic.key_insight: HVAF-sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr offered the best overall wear–corrosion balance, while HVOF achieved the highest measured hardness.
infographic.engineering_relevance: For wear- and corrosion-exposed 304 stainless steel components, HVAF is a promising coating process when both protection modes matter.
method: Deposited WC-10Co-4Cr on 304 stainless steel using APS, detonation, HVOF and HVAF spraying.
Compared microstructure, Vickers hardness, sliding wear, friction and corrosion behavior.
Examined wear tracks to identify abrasive and fatigue wear mechanisms.
infographic.evidence_signal: HVAF showed a wear rate of (1.10±0.01)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m), versus (36.82±0.80)×10⁻⁵ for uncoated steel, and ranked highest in corrosion resistance among the coatings.
infographic.watch_item: The abstract does not specify wear-test conditions or corrosion medium, limiting transfer of these rankings to service environments.
infographic.paper_title: Microstructure, Wear and Corrosion Resistances of Atmospheric Plasma, Detonation, High Velocity Oxy-fuel and High Velocity Air-fuel Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Cemented Carbide Coatings

zh-Hans.title: 大气等离子喷涂、爆炸喷涂、超音速火焰喷涂和超音速空气燃料喷涂WC-10Co-4Cr硬质合金涂层的显微组织、耐磨性和耐腐蚀性
zh-Hans.abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr硬质合金涂层具有优异的耐磨性和耐腐蚀性。采用大气等离子喷涂（APS）、爆炸喷涂（DS）、超音速火焰喷涂（HVOFS）和超音速空气燃料喷涂（HVAFS）等不同热喷涂技术，分别在304不锈钢基体上制备了WC-10Co-4Cr涂层。系统研究并比较了WC-10Co-4Cr涂层的显微组织、摩擦学性能和耐腐蚀性。结果表明，采用APS、DS、HVOF和HVAF制备的硬质合金涂层的维氏硬度分别为771.4 HV、954.2 HV、1166.2 HV和1162.2 HV，均高于304不锈钢。304不锈钢的体积磨损率约为(36.82±0.80)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m)。APS、DS、HVOF和HVAF涂层的体积磨损率分别约为(7.93±0.30)×10⁻⁵、(1.51±0.20)×10⁻⁵、(1.17±0.10)×10⁻⁵和(1.10±0.01)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m)，均低于304不锈钢。此外，304不锈钢基体、APS涂层、DS涂层、HVOF涂层和HVAF涂层的平均摩擦系数分别约为(0.68±0.03)、(0.56±0.02)、(0.48±0.01)、(0.44±0.01)和(0.43±0.01)。在WC-10Co-4Cr涂层的磨痕中可观察到剥落、垂直于摩擦方向的微裂纹以及平行于摩擦方向的沟槽。磨粒磨损和疲劳磨损是硬质合金涂层的主要磨损机制。在磨损试验过程中，DS、HVOF和HVAF涂层中的碳化物颗粒逐渐成为承受摩擦载荷的主体。因此，后三种涂层的耐磨性均优于APS涂层，其中HVOF和HVAF涂层的耐磨性能更好。耐腐蚀性由高到低依次为HVAF涂层、DS涂层、HVOF涂层和APS涂层。在本研究中，HVAF涂层表现出最高的腐蚀电位(-0.37±0.01 V_SCE)、最小的腐蚀电流密度(1.75±0.02 μA/cm²)和最大的腐蚀电阻(20438.5 Ω)。APS涂层在这四种涂层中的耐腐蚀性最差。

infographic.key_insight: HVAF喷涂的WC-10Co-4Cr涂层在耐磨性与耐腐蚀性之间表现出最佳的综合平衡，而HVOF涂层的实测硬度最高。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 对于承受磨损和腐蚀的304不锈钢部件，当两种防护性能均至关重要时，HVAF是一种有前景的涂层制备工艺。
method: 采用APS、爆炸喷涂、HVOF和HVAF在304不锈钢上沉积WC-10Co-4Cr涂层。
比较显微组织、维氏硬度、滑动磨损、摩擦和腐蚀行为。
检查磨痕，以识别磨粒磨损和疲劳磨损机制。
infographic.evidence_signal: HVAF涂层的磨损率为(1.10±0.01)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m)，而未涂覆不锈钢的磨损率为(36.82±0.80)×10⁻⁵ mm³/(N·m)；HVAF涂层的耐腐蚀性在各涂层中排名最高。
infographic.watch_item: 摘要未说明磨损试验条件或腐蚀介质，因此这些性能排序向实际服役环境的推广受到限制。

title: De-Risking Robotic Welding for In-Space Metal Joining Through Physics-Grounded Digital Twins
authors: Zhou Daniel Hao, Umer Masood Chaudry, Robert Shaw, Andrew Cheney, Nick Ludford, Mark Sims
abstract: Growing interest in in-space servicing, manufacturing, and assembly has renewed attention on reliable metal joining for modular construction and on-orbit repair. Robotic welding is promising, but reduced-gravity and low-pressure operation remains poorly characterised and flight-like tests are limited. The UK Space Agency-supported ISPARK project is developing a physics-grounded digital twin for structured process de-risking. This paper evaluates a model-based prototype combining a finite-volume thermal weld-pool model, Gaussian-process (GP) and neural-network surrogates, and a simulated six-axis manipulator. The reduced model includes solid-liquid phase change, effective thermocapillary transport, and a local-pressure parameter. Gravity is assessed separately through a hydrostatic-to-capillary pressure ratio and does not enter the thermal energy equation. Across repeated five-fold cross-validation, the GP has lower normalised mean absolute error than the neural network for all eight outputs. In 10 held-out boundary cases, 74 of 80 solver responses fall within nominal 90% GP predictive intervals. A three-output GP query takes 249 microseconds, including scaling and predictive variance. In a simulated UR5 L-shaped-seam study, a proportional controller adjusts the synergic power-source setting as travel speed falls near the corner. Finite-volume re-evaluation finds all 12 closed-loop operating points and 9 of 12 open-loop points within an illustrative 1.0-3.0 mm root-side-width band. These simulation results support using the framework to screen welding conditions and control strategies before experimental tests. Thermal-vacuum, targeted reduced-gravity, and robotic hardware-in-the-loop studies are needed to assess the model and controller.

infographic.key_insight: A physics-grounded digital twin combines weld-pool simulation, AI surrogates, and robotic control to screen welding conditions before costly in-space joining experiments.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The framework could help engineers select welding settings and adapt power to robot speed changes while targeting consistent root-side weld width.
method: Finite-volume thermal model includes phase change, effective thermocapillary transport, and local pressure; gravity is assessed separately.
Gaussian-process and neural-network surrogates predict weld responses from simulation data.
A simulated UR5 follows an L-shaped seam while proportional control adjusts the power-source setting.
infographic.evidence_signal: The GP outperformed the neural network on all eight outputs in repeated five-fold cross-validation; finite-volume checks placed 12/12 closed-loop versus 9/12 open-loop points within an illustrative 1–3 mm root-side-width band.
infographic.watch_item: Results are simulation-based; thermal-vacuum, reduced-gravity, and robotic hardware-in-the-loop tests are needed to assess model and controller validity.
infographic.paper_title: De-Risking Robotic Welding for In-Space Metal Joining Through Physics-Grounded Digital Twins

zh-Hans.title: 通过基于物理的数字孪生降低空间金属连接中机器人焊接的风险
zh-Hans.abstract: 人们对空间服务、制造与装配的兴趣日益增长，使模块化建造和在轨维修所需的可靠金属连接技术重新受到关注。机器人焊接具有应用前景，但对其在低重力和低压条件下的运行特性仍缺乏充分认识，且接近实际飞行条件的试验有限。英国航天局支持的 ISPARK 项目正在开发一种基于物理的数字孪生，以系统化地降低工艺风险。本文评估了一个基于模型的原型，该原型结合了有限体积法熔池热模型、高斯过程（GP）和神经网络代理模型，以及仿真六轴机械臂。该简化模型包含固液相变、有效热毛细输运和局部压力参数。重力影响通过静水压力与毛细压力之比单独评估，不纳入热能方程。在重复五折交叉验证中，GP 在全部八项输出上的归一化平均绝对误差均低于神经网络。在 10 个留出的边界案例中，80 个求解器响应中有 74 个落在 GP 的标称 90% 预测区间内。一次三输出 GP 查询耗时 249 微秒，包括数据缩放和预测方差计算。在一项仿真 UR5 沿 L 形焊缝运动的研究中，当行进速度在拐角附近下降时，比例控制器调整一元化焊接电源设定值。有限体积法重新评估发现，全部 12 个闭环工况点和 12 个开环工况点中的 9 个均处于示例性的 1.0-3.0 mm 根部侧焊缝宽度范围内。这些仿真结果支持在实验测试前使用该框架筛选焊接条件和控制策略。仍需开展热真空试验、有针对性的低重力试验以及机器人硬件在环研究，以评估模型和控制器。

infographic.key_insight: 基于物理的数字孪生将熔池仿真、AI 代理模型和机器人控制相结合，用于在成本高昂的空间连接实验之前筛选焊接条件。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该框架可帮助工程师选择焊接设定值，并根据机器人速度变化调整功率，以实现一致的根部侧焊缝宽度。
method: 有限体积法热模型包含相变、有效热毛细输运和局部压力；重力影响单独评估。
高斯过程和神经网络代理模型基于仿真数据预测焊接响应。
仿真 UR5 沿 L 形焊缝运动，同时通过比例控制调整电源设定值。
infographic.evidence_signal: 在重复五折交叉验证中，GP 在全部八项输出上均优于神经网络；有限体积法核验表明，12/12 个闭环工况点和 9/12 个开环工况点处于示例性的 1–3 mm 根部侧焊缝宽度范围内。
infographic.watch_item: 结果基于仿真；仍需开展热真空、低重力和机器人硬件在环试验，以评估模型和控制器的有效性。

title: Microstructure and High-Temperature Oxidation Behaviour of HVOF and Plasma Sprayed Ni–Cr-Based Ceramic Coatings on SA516 Boiler Steel
authors: Ankur Gill, Vikas Chawla, Amit Handa, Santosh Kumar
abstract: This study investigates the microstructural and high-temperature oxidation behaviour of SA516 boiler steel coated with Ni-20Cr, Ni-20Cr+40TiC, and Ni-20Cr+40TiN using High Velocity Oxygen Fuel (HVOF) and Plasma Spray (PS) techniques. The cyclic air oxidation tests were performed for fifty cycles at 900°C in a simulated laboratory environment, and the resulting microstructural and phase changes were analyzed by means of X-ray Diffraction (XRD), Scanning Electron Microscopy with Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy (SEM/EDS), and X-ray mapping. The uncoated SA516 steel experienced intense spalling and cracking of the oxide layer, developing an unprotected phase (Fe 2 O 3 ). Among all coatings, the HVOF-sprayed Ni-20Cr+40TiC coating diminished maximum weight gain by 95.71 % compared to bare SA516 steel, indicating superior oxidation resistance. This enhanced performance of coatings is attributed to formation a dense, protective oxide layer consisting of Cr 2 O 3 , TiO 2 , NiTiO 4 , and NiO, coupled with reduced porosity and enhanced microhardness.

infographic.key_insight: HVOF-sprayed Ni-20Cr+40TiC reduced oxidation weight gain by 95.71% relative to bare SA516 boiler steel during cyclic testing at 900°C.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Ni–Cr-based coatings, particularly HVOF Ni-20Cr+40TiC, offer a promising route to improve high-temperature oxidation resistance of SA516 boiler components.
method: Applied Ni-20Cr, Ni-20Cr+40TiC, and Ni-20Cr+40TiN coatings using HVOF and plasma spraying.
Conducted 50 cyclic air-oxidation tests at 900°C.
Characterized microstructure and phases using XRD, SEM/EDS, and X-ray mapping.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports severe oxide spalling and cracking on bare steel, while coated samples developed protective oxides including Cr2O3, TiO2, NiTiO4, and NiO.
infographic.watch_item: Results are limited to laboratory air oxidation; long-term durability in actual boiler environments remains to be established.
infographic.paper_title: Microstructure and High-Temperature Oxidation Behaviour of HVOF and Plasma Sprayed Ni–Cr-Based Ceramic Coatings on SA516 Boiler Steel

zh-Hans.title: SA516锅炉钢表面HVOF及等离子喷涂Ni–Cr基陶瓷涂层的微观组织与高温氧化行为
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究采用高速氧燃料喷涂（HVOF）和等离子喷涂（PS）技术，在SA516锅炉钢表面制备Ni-20Cr、Ni-20Cr+40TiC和Ni-20Cr+40TiN涂层，并研究其微观组织与高温氧化行为。在实验室模拟环境中，于900°C下进行50个循环的空气氧化试验，并采用X射线衍射（XRD）、配备能量色散谱分析的扫描电子显微镜（SEM/EDS）及X射线元素面分布分析，研究由此产生的微观组织和物相变化。未涂覆的SA516钢氧化层发生严重剥落和开裂，并形成不具保护性的物相（Fe2O3）。在所有涂层中，HVOF喷涂Ni-20Cr+40TiC涂层使最大增重较裸露SA516钢降低了95.71%，表现出优异的抗氧化性能。涂层性能的提升归因于形成了由Cr2O3、TiO2、NiTiO4和NiO组成的致密保护性氧化层，同时孔隙率降低、显微硬度提高。

infographic.key_insight: 在900°C循环试验中，HVOF喷涂Ni-20Cr+40TiC涂层使氧化增重较裸露SA516锅炉钢降低了95.71%。
infographic.engineering_relevance: Ni–Cr基涂层，尤其是HVOF喷涂Ni-20Cr+40TiC涂层，为提高SA516锅炉部件的高温抗氧化性能提供了一条有前景的途径。
method: 采用HVOF和等离子喷涂制备Ni-20Cr、Ni-20Cr+40TiC和Ni-20Cr+40TiN涂层。
在900°C下进行50次循环空气氧化试验。
采用XRD、SEM/EDS和X射线元素面分布分析表征微观组织与物相。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告称，裸钢表面的氧化层发生严重剥落和开裂，而涂覆样品形成了包括Cr2O3、TiO2、NiTiO4和NiO在内的保护性氧化物。
infographic.watch_item: 结果仅限于实验室空气氧化条件；在实际锅炉环境中的长期耐久性仍有待验证。

title: Molten pool dynamic behavior and arc characteristics in laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel
authors: Sen WU, Fei ZHAO, Shuili GONG, Lifeng MA, Haiyan ZHAO, Wei ZHANG
abstract: Invar steel has an extremely low coefficient of thermal expansion, making it widely used in the manufacturing of molds for aerospace composite materials. Most existing studies focus on process aspects, lacking in-depth analysis of the fluid dynamics behavior of the molten pool. Therefore, numerical simulation and high-speed photography were employed to analyze the effects of different process parameters on the molten pool morphology evolution and arc characteristics during laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel, which provides crucial theoretical support for the optimization of the Invar steel welding process. The results indicate that within the laser power range of 5 ~ 6 kW, the increased power leads to greater recoil pressure, which promotes a larger penetration depth and keyhole dimension, intensifies the overall molten pool flow, and makes the arc prone to being attracted by the laser and deflected at a high power. Within the welding speed range of 0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min, a higher speed reduces the heat input, leading to a decreased penetration depth and weld width, and an increased flow velocity and cooling rate of the molten pool; additionally, the arc is prone to deformation at a high speed. Within the welding current range of 150 ~ 170 A, the increased current enhances the arc force, promoting the expansion of weld width and intensifying the molten pool convection; furthermore, the arc is more stable at a high current.

infographic.key_insight: In laser–TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel, laser power primarily increases penetration, welding speed reduces weld dimensions, and current broadens the weld while stabilizing the arc.
infographic.engineering_relevance: These parameter–response relationships can guide weld geometry and arc stability control for Invar tooling used in aerospace composite manufacturing.
method: Numerical simulation of molten-pool dynamics.
High-speed photography of welding behavior.
Analysis across laser power, welding speed, and current ranges.
infographic.evidence_signal: Across 5–6 kW, 0.5–0.8 m/min, and 150–170 A, the abstract reports distinct changes in penetration, pool flow, weld width, and arc behavior.
infographic.watch_item: The abstract provides trends within limited parameter ranges but no quantitative simulation–experiment agreement or validated optimal settings.

zh-Hans.title: Invar钢激光-TIG复合焊接中的熔池动态行为与电弧特性
zh-Hans.abstract: Invar钢具有极低的热膨胀系数，因此广泛用于航空航天复合材料成型模具的制造。现有研究大多侧重于工艺方面，缺乏对熔池流体动力学行为的深入分析。因此，本研究采用数值模拟和高速摄影，分析了不同工艺参数对Invar钢激光-TIG复合焊接过程中熔池形貌演变及电弧特性的影响，为Invar钢焊接工艺优化提供了重要的理论支持。结果表明，在5 ~ 6 kW的激光功率范围内，功率增大使反冲压力增大，从而增大熔深和小孔尺寸，加剧熔池整体流动，且在高功率下电弧易受激光吸引而发生偏转。在0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min的焊接速度范围内，焊接速度增大使热输入降低，导致熔深和焊缝宽度减小、熔池流速和冷却速率增大；此外，高速下电弧易发生变形。在150 ~ 170 A的焊接电流范围内，电流增大使电弧力增强，促进焊缝宽度增大并加剧熔池对流；此外，高电流下电弧更加稳定。

infographic.key_insight: 在Invar钢激光–TIG复合焊接中，激光功率主要增大熔深，焊接速度增大使焊缝尺寸减小，而电流增大则使焊缝变宽并提高电弧稳定性。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这些参数–响应关系可为航空航天复合材料制造用Invar工装的焊缝几何形状与电弧稳定性控制提供指导。
method: 熔池动力学数值模拟。
焊接行为高速摄影。

infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告了在5–6 kW、0.5–0.8 m/min和150–170 A范围内，熔深、熔池流动、焊缝宽度及电弧行为的不同变化。

title: INVESTIGATION OF THE FORMATION OF STRUCTURE AND WEAR-RESISTANT PROPERTIES OF WC–CO–CR COATINGS PRODUCED BY HVOF AND DETONATION SPRAYING
authors: Arystanbek Kussainov, G.Zh. Zhunissova, Ermakhan Molbossynov, Нуртолеу Магазов, Rashid Kuanyshbay
abstract: The article presents a comparative analysis of WC–Co–Cr cermet coatings deposited by detonation spray (DS) and High Velocity Oxy-Fuel (HVOF) methods. The study included an analysis of the morphology of the initial powders, as well as the microstructure and phase composition of the coatings using Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) and Energy Dispersive Spectroscopy (EDS). The results show that the use of homogeneous, fully alloyed WC–Co–Cr powder ensures the formation of a dense, layered structure with a uniform distribution of the carbide phase within the metallic matrix. Detonation spraying produces a harder coating (average microhardness 1449 HV), whereas HVOF provides a coating with high density, uniform microstructure, and low friction coefficient (Kt = 0.143). The comparative analysis confirmed that the mechanical and tribological properties of the coatings strongly depend on the powder morphology and the spraying method. These findings allow for the determination of optimal processing conditions for WC–Co–Cr coatings, enhancing wear resistance and durability of machine parts, which is particularly relevant for operation under intensive friction and high load conditions.

infographic.key_insight: WC–Co–Cr coating properties depend on powder morphology and spray method: detonation spraying favors hardness, while HVOF yields a dense, uniform coating with low friction.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Selecting the powder and deposition route can improve wear resistance and durability of machine parts exposed to intensive friction and high loads.
method: Compared detonation-sprayed and HVOF WC–Co–Cr coatings.

zh-Hans.title: HVOF与爆炸喷涂制备WC–Co–Cr涂层的组织形成及耐磨性能研究
zh-Hans.abstract: 本文对采用爆炸喷涂（DS）和超音速火焰喷涂（HVOF）方法沉积的WC–Co–Cr金属陶瓷涂层进行了对比分析。研究采用扫描电子显微镜（SEM）和能量色散谱（EDS），分析了原始粉末的形貌以及涂层的微观组织和相组成。结果表明，使用均质、完全合金化的WC–Co–Cr粉末可确保形成致密的层状组织，且碳化物相在金属基体中均匀分布。爆炸喷涂制备的涂层硬度更高（平均显微硬度为1449 HV），而HVOF制备的涂层具有高致密度、均匀的微观组织和低摩擦系数（Kt = 0.143）。对比分析证实，涂层的力学性能和摩擦学性能在很大程度上取决于粉末形貌及喷涂方法。这些研究结果有助于确定WC–Co–Cr涂层的最佳工艺条件，提高机械零件的耐磨性和耐久性，对强烈摩擦和高载荷条件下的运行尤为重要。

infographic.key_insight: WC–Co–Cr涂层的性能取决于粉末形貌和喷涂方法：爆炸喷涂有利于提高硬度，而HVOF可制备致密、均匀且摩擦系数低的涂层。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 选择适当的粉末和沉积工艺路线，可提高承受强烈摩擦和高载荷的机械零件的耐磨性与耐久性。

infographic.watch_item: 摘要未提供试验条件、变异性及定量磨损率，限制了对特定服役条件下耐久性的评估。

title: Development of a Method for Producing Self-Fluxing Nickel-Based Coatings by Detonation Spraying
authors: Dastan Buitkenov, Laila Sulyubayeva, Daryn Baizhan, Nurmakhanbet Raisov, Nurkhat Bimakhan
abstract: This study investigated the influence of detonation spraying parameters on the structure and tribological and mechanical properties of self-fluxing coatings of the Ni–Cr–Fe–B–Si–C system. The investigated parameters included the barrel filling level (48–68%), the molar ratio of the working gases (O/C = 1.026–1.856), and the inter-shot delay (0–1 s). Morphological analysis of the coatings revealed a characteristic lamellar structure and a dependence of coating thickness and defect formation on the spraying conditions. A lower barrel filling level resulted in a denser coating structure with minimal porosity, whereas medium and high filling levels promoted the formation of microcracks, presumably due to increased residual stresses. Tribological tests showed that the minimum coefficient of friction was obtained at a barrel filling level of 48% (μ = 0.674 ± 0.136) and an O/C ratio of 1.026, but these conditions were also associated with increased wear. The highest wear resistance was obtained at an O/C ratio of 1.856 and an increased inter-shot delay of up to 1 s, resulting in a decrease in the specific wear rate to 0.000189 mm³/(N·m). Roughness analysis showed that increasing the inter-shot delay reduced Ra from 5.00 to 3.60 μm, which may be attributed to a reduction in thermal load and more favorable coating formation conditions. The maximum hardness, up to 905.6 HV, was obtained for a combination of parameters that promoted the formation of a dense structure and strengthening phases. The results indicate that optimizing the detonation spraying parameters requires a trade-off between reducing the coefficient of friction and increasing wear resistance. The findings can be used to develop tech nologies for the restoration and surface strengthening of machine components.
venue: Bulletin of the Karaganda University Physics Series

infographic.key_insight: Detonation-sprayed Ni–Cr–Fe–B–Si–C coatings require a trade-off between low friction and high wear resistance, controlled by barrel filling, gas ratio, and inter-shot delay.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Tuning these parameters can improve coatings for restoring and surface-strengthening machine components.

zh-Hans.title: 爆炸喷涂制备自熔性镍基涂层的方法开发
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了爆炸喷涂参数对Ni–Cr–Fe–B–Si–C体系自熔性涂层组织、摩擦学性能和力学性能的影响。所考察的参数包括喷枪身管填充率（48–68%）、工作气体摩尔比（O/C = 1.026–1.856）和喷射间隔时间（0–1 s）。涂层形貌分析显示，涂层具有典型的层片状组织，且涂层厚度和缺陷形成取决于喷涂条件。较低的身管填充率可形成孔隙率极低的致密涂层组织，而中等和较高填充率则促进微裂纹形成，这可能是由残余应力增大所致。摩擦学试验表明，在身管填充率为48%、O/C比为1.026时，获得了最低摩擦系数（μ = 0.674 ± 0.136），但这些条件也伴随着磨损增加。在O/C比为1.856、喷射间隔时间延长至最高1 s时，获得了最高耐磨性，比磨损率降至0.000189 mm³/(N·m)。粗糙度分析表明，延长喷射间隔时间使Ra从5.00 μm降至3.60 μm，这可能归因于热负荷降低以及更有利的涂层形成条件。在有利于形成致密组织和强化相的参数组合下，获得了最高硬度，达905.6 HV。结果表明，优化爆炸喷涂参数需要在降低摩擦系数与提高耐磨性之间进行权衡。这些研究结果可用于开发机械零部件修复和表面强化技术。

infographic.key_insight: 爆炸喷涂Ni–Cr–Fe–B–Si–C涂层需要在低摩擦与高耐磨性之间进行权衡，这一权衡受身管填充率、气体比例和喷射间隔时间控制。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 调节这些参数可改善用于机械零部件修复和表面强化的涂层。
method: 将身管填充率在48–68%范围内、工作气体摩尔比O/C在1.026–1.856范围内、喷射间隔时间在0–1 s范围内进行调整。
评估涂层形貌、摩擦、比磨损率、粗糙度和硬度。

title: A Comparative Analysis of Multitask Neural Networks and Stacking Ensemble Learning for Predicting UTS, Weld Hardness, and HAZ Hardness in Welding Applications
authors: Sama Mukhtar, Amit Sata, Gaurang Joshi, Durgesh Srivastava
abstract: Accurately predicting welding performance measures like ultimate strength (UTS), weld bead hardness, and HAZ mechanical hardness is crucial for ensuring the structural integrity and performance of welded components. Multitask learning (MTL) refers to a machine learning approach in which one model is designed to handle several interconnected tasks at the same time. Instead of training separate models for each task, MTL shares representations among tasks, allowing them to leverage common patterns while maintaining task-specific distinctions. In this study, we compared two advanced machine learning techniques, namely multitask neural network (MTNN) and stacking ensemble learning, for predicting these parameters based on a shared dataset. A multitask neural network (MTNN) is a specific type of multitask learning (MTL) model that uses a deep neural network architecture to handle multiple related tasks simultaneously. In MTNN, different tasks share some hidden layers while having task-specific output layers. This shared representation allows the model to learn common patterns across tasks while maintaining task-specific outputs. Both methods are evaluated using RMSE and R<sup>2</sup> to determine their predictive accuracy and overall effectiveness. It showed robust prediction strength, as its RMSE outcomes are 0.1288 for UTS, 0.0886 for weld hardness, and 0.1125 for HAZ hardness, whereas R<sup>2</sup> values are 0.6724, 0.9215, and 0.8407, respectively. This underlines that it can generalize well in interrelated tasks. Stacking ensemble learning outperformed MTL in the accuracy of individual tasks: the RMSE for UTS is 0.0263 and R<sup>2</sup> is 0.9863; for weld hardness, it is 0.0467 and 0.9782; and for HAZ hardness, it is 0.1109 and 0.8453. Such results indicate the good ability of ensemble methods to produce highly accurate, task-specific predictions. This comparison reveals the trade-offs between the two approaches. MTL is good in scenarios where the tasks are related and the data are sparse, giving efficient training and good generalization; stacking ensembles work better in the case of accurate, independent predictions. In both cases, they show remarkable potential for improving the predictive power of welding applications, making them suitable precursors to further investigation into hybrid models that bring the best features of both approaches together.

infographic.key_insight: Stacking ensemble learning outperformed the multitask neural network in predicting UTS, weld hardness, and HAZ hardness, with the largest gains for UTS.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Accurate weld-property predictions could support process optimization and structural-integrity assessment.

zh-Hans.title: 多任务神经网络与堆叠集成学习在焊接应用中预测极限抗拉强度（UTS）、焊缝硬度和热影响区（HAZ）硬度的对比分析
zh-Hans.abstract: 准确预测极限抗拉强度（UTS）、焊道硬度和热影响区（HAZ）机械硬度等焊接性能指标，对于确保焊接构件的结构完整性和性能至关重要。多任务学习（MTL）是一种机器学习方法，其设计目标是让一个模型同时处理多个相互关联的任务。MTL并非为每个任务分别训练模型，而是在任务之间共享表征，使各任务能够利用共同模式，同时保留任务特有的差异。本研究基于同一数据集，对比了多任务神经网络（MTNN）和堆叠集成学习这两种先进机器学习技术在预测上述参数方面的表现。多任务神经网络（MTNN）是一类特定的多任务学习（MTL）模型，采用深度神经网络架构同时处理多个相关任务。在MTNN中，不同任务共享部分隐藏层，同时具有各自的任务专属输出层。这种共享表征使模型能够学习跨任务的共同模式，同时保留任务专属输出。两种方法均采用RMSE和R²进行评估，以确定其预测精度和总体有效性。该模型表现出较强的预测能力，其对UTS、焊缝硬度和HAZ硬度的RMSE分别为0.1288、0.0886和0.1125，对应的R²分别为0.6724、0.9215和0.8407。这表明它能够在相互关联的任务中实现良好的泛化。堆叠集成学习在各单项任务的预测精度上优于MTL：对于UTS，RMSE为0.0263，R²为0.9863；对于焊缝硬度，二者分别为0.0467和0.9782；对于HAZ硬度，二者分别为0.1109和0.8453。这些结果表明，集成方法具有较强的能力，能够针对特定任务生成高精度预测。该对比揭示了两种方法之间的权衡。MTL适用于任务相关且数据稀疏的场景，可实现高效训练和良好泛化；堆叠集成则在需要精确、独立预测的情况下表现更好。两种方法均展现出提升焊接应用预测能力的显著潜力，可作为进一步研究融合两者优势的混合模型的良好基础。

infographic.key_insight: 堆叠集成学习在预测UTS、焊缝硬度和HAZ硬度方面优于多任务神经网络，其中UTS的预测性能提升最大。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 准确预测焊缝性能有望支持工艺优化和结构完整性评估。
method: 对比共享隐藏层的多任务神经网络与堆叠集成学习。
使用同一数据集预测UTS、焊缝硬度和热影响区（HAZ）硬度。
使用RMSE和R²评估每个预测目标。
infographic.evidence_signal: 堆叠集成学习对UTS、焊缝硬度和HAZ硬度的R²分别达到0.9863、0.9782和0.8453，而多任务网络的对应值分别为0.6724、0.9215和0.8407。

title: Long-term corrosion behaviors and wear behavior of Fe-based amorphous coatings in different humidity environments
authors: Shuai Cui, Haimin Zhai, Zihan Feng, Xuqiang Li, Wensheng Li, Xiangjuan Fan
abstract: Fe-based amorphous coatings (Fe-based AMCs) were successfully prepared on Q235 carbon steel by detonation spray under different spraying parameters. The corrosion and tribology behaviors of coatings were systematically tested. The droplets show disk-like morphology with the highest circularity and expansion factor, which is crucial to reduce the defects of coatings and to form fine-lamellar-structures coatings with dense microstructure. A higher incidence of porosity defects in the coating is associated with reduced long-term corrosion resistance. Moreover, the tribo-chemical reactions between Si3N4 balls and water molecules play a significant role in wear behaviors for coating in different humidity conditions. The friction coefficient and wear rate of coatings decrease as the humidity conditions increase.

infographic.key_insight: Dense, low-porosity Fe-based amorphous coatings improve long-term corrosion resistance, while higher humidity reduces friction and wear.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Detonation-spray parameters should be tuned to minimize coating defects, with service humidity considered when assessing wear performance.
method: Detonation-spray Fe-based amorphous coatings onto Q235 carbon steel under varied spraying parameters.
Characterize droplet morphology and coating microstructure.
Evaluate corrosion and tribological behavior across humidity conditions.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports poorer long-term corrosion resistance with greater porosity and decreasing friction coefficients and wear rates as humidity increases.
infographic.watch_item: Humidity-dependent wear results involve Si3N4 counterfaces and may not generalize to other contact materials; quantitative performance ranges are not provided in the abstract.
infographic.paper_title: Long-term corrosion behaviors and wear behavior of Fe-based amorphous coatings in different humidity environments

zh-Hans.title: 不同湿度环境下铁基非晶涂层的长期腐蚀行为和磨损行为
zh-Hans.abstract: 采用不同喷涂参数，通过爆炸喷涂在Q235碳钢上成功制备了铁基非晶涂层（Fe-based AMCs）。系统测试了涂层的腐蚀行为和摩擦学行为。液滴呈圆盘状，具有最高的圆度和铺展因子，这对于减少涂层缺陷、形成具有致密显微组织的细层片结构涂层至关重要。涂层中孔隙缺陷的增多与长期耐腐蚀性的降低相关。此外，Si3N4球与水分子之间的摩擦化学反应对不同湿度条件下涂层的磨损行为具有重要影响。涂层的摩擦系数和磨损率随湿度升高而降低。

infographic.key_insight: 致密、低孔隙率的铁基非晶涂层可提高长期耐腐蚀性，而较高湿度可降低摩擦和磨损。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 应调整爆炸喷涂参数，以尽量减少涂层缺陷，并在评估磨损性能时考虑服役环境湿度。
method: 采用不同喷涂参数，通过爆炸喷涂在Q235碳钢上制备铁基非晶涂层。
表征液滴形貌和涂层显微组织。
评估不同湿度条件下的腐蚀行为和摩擦学行为。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告，孔隙率越高，长期耐腐蚀性越差；随着湿度升高，摩擦系数和磨损率均降低。

title: EFFECT OF FLAME-SPRAYING TEMPERATURE ON THE PROPERTIES OF Ni–Cr–B–Si-BASED SELF-FLUXING COATINGS
authors: Dastan Buitkenov, Manarbek Kylyshkanov, Daryn Baizhan, Nurmakhanbet Raisov, Nurkhat Bimakhan
abstract: The present study investigates the effect of flame-spraying process parameters on the microstructure and mechanical properties of Ni–Cr–B–Si-based self-fluxing coatings. Corrosion-resistant AISI 321 austenitic chromium–nickel steel was used as the substrate material. The coatings were deposited by flame spraying using a Metal Coat 6PM-II system. To vary the thermal conditions of the spraying process, the oxygen-to-acetylene (O₂/C₂H₂) ratio was adjusted to 1.0, 1.1, and 1.2. The spraying parameters were monitored using an Accuraspray 4.0 diagnostic system. The resulting coatings were characterized in terms of microstructure, porosity, microhardness, surface roughness, and adhesion strength. Increasing the O₂/C₂H₂ ratio resulted in densification of the coating structure and a decrease in porosity from 1.97 ± 0.13% to 0.90 ± 0.09%. Concurrently, the surface roughness decreased from 4.70 ± 0.09 μm to 2.99 ± 0.11 μm, while the adhesion strength increased from 22.14 ± 4.3 MPa to 35.02 ± 3.9 MPa. The highest average microhardness of 1051.7 HV was obtained at an O₂/C₂H₂ ratio of 1.1. Among the investigated spraying conditions, the coating produced at O₂/C₂H₂ = 1.2 exhibited the lowest porosity and surface roughness together with the highest adhesion strength. The results demonstrate that controlling the O₂/C₂H₂ ratio provides an effective means of tailoring the microstructural and mechanical characteristics of flame-sprayed Ni–Cr–B–Si-based self-fluxing coatings.

zh-Hans.title: 火焰喷涂温度对Ni–Cr–B–Si基自熔性涂层性能的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究探讨了火焰喷涂工艺参数对Ni–Cr–B–Si基自熔性涂层微观组织和力学性能的影响。采用耐腐蚀的AISI 321奥氏体铬镍钢作为基体材料，使用Metal Coat 6PM-II系统通过火焰喷涂制备涂层。为改变喷涂过程的热条件，将氧气与乙炔的比值（O₂/C₂H₂）分别调整为1.0、1.1和1.2。采用Accuraspray 4.0诊断系统监测喷涂参数，并对所得涂层的微观组织、孔隙率、显微硬度、表面粗糙度和结合强度进行表征。随着O₂/C₂H₂比值增大，涂层组织趋于致密，孔隙率由1.97 ± 0.13%降至0.90 ± 0.09%。同时，表面粗糙度由4.70 ± 0.09 μm降至2.99 ± 0.11 μm，而结合强度由22.14 ± 4.3 MPa增至35.02 ± 3.9 MPa。当O₂/C₂H₂比值为1.1时，获得最高平均显微硬度1051.7 HV。在所研究的喷涂条件中，O₂/C₂H₂ = 1.2时制备的涂层具有最低的孔隙率和表面粗糙度，同时具有最高的结合强度。结果表明，控制O₂/C₂H₂比值是调控火焰喷涂Ni–Cr–B–Si基自熔性涂层微观组织和力学特性的有效手段。

title: Biomaterials and biomechanical design of distal weight-bearing implants: Computational modeling, biomaterial interfaces, and clinical translation
authors: Muntadher Saleh Mahdi, Ayad M. Takhakh, Mohamed Hamdy Doweidar
abstract: Distal Weight-Bearing Implants (DWBIs) represent a clinically emerging class of load-bearing medical devices in which biomaterial design, surface architecture, and biomechanical performance are tightly coupled. Their success depends not only on restoring distal support in transfemoral rehabilitation, but also on the ability of metallic, ceramic, and composite biomaterial interfaces to sustain cyclic loading while promoting durable bone-implant integration. However, distal support also changes bending moments, shear stresses, micromotion, coating durability, and biological demands at the bone-implant interface. This systematic review synthesizes DWBI concepts, geometry optimization, finite element analysis with gait-phase loading, Functionally Graded Materials (FGMs), graded Ti-HAp (hydroxyapatite) architectures, in-vivo osseointegration evidence, and clinical translation pathways. A quantitative trend analysis was performed on 34 direct-contribution papers and 32 empirical studies to assess trends, validation depth, and translation readiness. However, more than half of the empirical evidence remained at the bench or simulation level, while animal and human/clinical studies formed a smaller validation layer. HAp-centered surface or bulk material engineering represented a substantial share of the corpus; however, evidence for graded Ti-HAp/FGM architectures was derived predominantly from non-DWBI biomaterial and mechanistic analog studies, supporting mechanistic plausibility rather than DWBI-specific validation. Mechanistically, DWBI should be interpreted as an integrated biomaterial-mechanical system linking macro-geometry, metallic/ceramic surface architecture, graded Ti-HAp interfaces, gait-phase loading, tribology/corrosion behavior, in-vivo fixation, and clinical workflow. Translation will require patient-realistic loading conditions, validated finite element analysis workflows, device-level fatigue and coating-integrity testing, standardized in-vivo endpoints, harmonized rehabilitation protocols, and registry-supported clinical follow-up linking mechanical plausibility to durable biological fixation and patient-level benefit.

infographic.engineering_relevance: Implant design must balance gait-dependent stresses and micromotion with coating integrity, fatigue resistance, and biological fixation.

zh-Hans.title: 远端承重植入物的生物材料与生物力学设计：计算建模、生物材料界面及临床转化
zh-Hans.abstract: 远端承重植入物（DWBIs）是一类正在临床兴起的承重医疗器械，其生物材料设计、表面结构与生物力学性能紧密耦合。其成功不仅取决于恢复经股截肢康复中的远端支撑，还取决于金属、陶瓷及复合生物材料界面在承受循环载荷的同时促进持久骨-植入物整合的能力。然而，远端支撑也会改变骨-植入物界面的弯矩、剪应力、微动、涂层耐久性及生物学需求。本系统综述综合梳理了DWBI概念、几何优化、考虑步态时相载荷的有限元分析、功能梯度材料（FGMs）、梯度Ti-HAp（羟基磷灰石）结构、体内骨整合证据及临床转化路径。对34篇具有直接贡献的论文和32项实证研究进行了定量趋势分析，以评估研究趋势、验证深度及转化就绪程度。然而，超过一半的实证证据仍停留在台架试验或仿真层面，而动物研究和人体/临床研究构成的验证层占比较小。以HAp为核心的表面或块体材料工程在所纳入文献中占有相当比例；然而，梯度Ti-HAp/FGM结构的证据主要来自非DWBI的生物材料研究及机制类比研究，支持的是机制上的合理性，而非针对DWBI的专门验证。从机制角度看，DWBI应被理解为一个一体化的生物材料-力学系统，将宏观几何形态、金属/陶瓷表面结构、梯度Ti-HAp界面、步态时相载荷、摩擦学/腐蚀行为、体内固定及临床工作流程联系起来。实现转化需要符合患者实际情况的载荷条件、经过验证的有限元分析流程、器械层面的疲劳及涂层完整性测试、标准化的体内评价终点、协调一致的康复方案，以及由登记系统支持的临床随访，以将力学上的合理性与持久的生物学固定及患者层面的获益联系起来。

title: Enhancing weld performance of AA2024-T351 using drilled-to-bossed geometry and deep learning prediction in direct drive friction welding
authors: Eyob Messele Sefene, Alemayehu Admas Abay, Akshansh Mishra, Assefa Asmare Tsegaw, William Gomez, Addisalem Desalegn Sisay
abstract: Abstract The growing demand for lightweight, high-strength materials in the aerospace and automotive industries has brought aluminium alloys such as AA2024-T351 into the spotlight due to their outstanding strength-to-weight ratio. However, achieving reliable joints in such alloys remains a significant challenge, particularly when using conventional welding techniques. To address this, the present study focuses on optimizing process parameters in Direct Drive Friction Welding (DDFW) for AA2024-T351. A novel drilled-to-bossed geometry, inspired by the traditional mortise-and-tenon joint, is introduced to enhance mechanical interlocking and improve weld integrity. Experimental trials were systematically designed using an L18 orthogonal array to evaluate both tensile and torsional strength. The experiments were conducted on a customized engine lathe, with friction pressure, forging pressure, spindle speed, faying surface geometry, and friction time selected as the controllable process parameters. In parallel, advanced deep learning models, including an ensemble residual network, a compact attention network, and an adaptive multiscale network, were implemented to predict ultimate tensile strength based on the welding conditions. The results revealed that the optimal parameter combination of 30 MPa friction pressure, 70 MPa forging pressure, 2200 rpm spindle speed, drilled-to-bossed geometry, and 4 min of friction time yielded exceptional mechanical performance, achieving a tensile strength of 538 MPa and torsional strength of 325 MPa. The drilled-to-bossed configuration demonstrated significantly higher joint strength compared to conventional flat-to-flat joints. Moreover, among the deep learning models, the ensemble residual network achieved the highest predictive accuracy with an R² value of approximately 0.81, effectively capturing the complex relationship between process parameters and weld strength.

infographic.engineering_relevance: Combining mechanical interlocking with process optimization could improve lightweight aluminium joints for aerospace and automotive applications.
method: Tested direct drive friction welding on a customized engine lathe using an L18 orthogonal array.

zh-Hans.title: 采用钻孔-凸台配合结构与深度学习预测提升AA2024-T351直接驱动摩擦焊的焊接性能
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 航空航天和汽车行业对轻质高强材料的需求日益增长，使AA2024-T351等铝合金因其优异的强度重量比而备受关注。然而，实现此类合金的可靠连接仍是一项重大挑战，尤其是在采用传统焊接技术时。为此，本研究着重优化AA2024-T351直接驱动摩擦焊（DDFW）的工艺参数。受传统榫卯接头启发，引入了一种新型钻孔-凸台配合结构，以增强机械互锁并改善焊接完整性。采用L18正交表系统设计试验，以评估抗拉强度和抗扭强度。试验在一台定制改装的普通车床上进行，选取摩擦压力、顶锻压力、主轴转速、接合面几何形状和摩擦时间作为可控工艺参数。同时，采用包括集成残差网络、紧凑型注意力网络和自适应多尺度网络在内的先进深度学习模型，根据焊接条件预测极限抗拉强度。结果表明，由30 MPa摩擦压力、70 MPa顶锻压力、2200 rpm主轴转速、钻孔-凸台配合结构和4 min摩擦时间组成的最优参数组合获得了优异的力学性能，抗拉强度达到538 MPa，抗扭强度达到325 MPa。与传统平面-平面接头相比，钻孔-凸台配合结构表现出显著更高的接头强度。此外，在所采用的深度学习模型中，集成残差网络的预测精度最高，R²值约为0.81，有效捕捉了工艺参数与焊接强度之间的复杂关系。

title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions
authors: Vyacheslav Sirota, Sergey Savotchenko, Valeriya Strokova, Daniil Podgornyi, Marina Kovaleva
abstract: The surface properties of metal-ceramic coatings based on titanium dioxide are described in dependence on the detonation spraying conditions. It is found that such properties as surface roughness, surface thickness and its hydrophobicity can be controlled in the production process by selecting certain values of the technological parameters of the spraying process. The optimal values of the technological parameters of detonation spraying, ensuring maximum hydrophobicity of the produced coatings are determined. The roughness of the coating surface and the coating thickness depend on the speed of the nozzle passage in accordance with the inverse power law. The roughness and the contact angle depend on spray distance in accordance with a parabolic law. New equations are obtained that can be useful for predicting the characteristics of the coating surface, as well as for determining the optimal mode of spraying the coating, ensuring its best hydrophobicity.
venue: Iranian Journal of Materials Science and Engineering

zh-Hans.title: 不同工艺条件下爆炸喷涂制备的钛基涂层的表面特性
zh-Hans.abstract: 本文描述了二氧化钛基金属陶瓷涂层的表面性能与爆炸喷涂条件之间的关系。研究发现，通过选择喷涂工艺参数的特定值，可以在生产过程中控制表面粗糙度、表层厚度及其疏水性等性能。确定了使所制备涂层具有最大疏水性的爆炸喷涂工艺参数最优值。涂层表面粗糙度和涂层厚度与喷嘴移动速度之间遵循反幂律关系。粗糙度和接触角与喷涂距离之间遵循抛物线关系。研究获得了新的方程，可用于预测涂层表面特性，以及确定使涂层具有最佳疏水性的最优喷涂工艺条件。

title: HARDNESS AND POST-SCRATCH SURFACE MORPHOLOGY OF Cr₃C₂–NiCr COATINGS AFTER ULTRASONIC NANOCRYSTAL SURFACE MODIFICATION
authors: Arystanbek Kussainov, Indira Abizhanova, M.K. Kaliaskarova, Yermakhan Molbossynov, Нуртолеу Магазов
abstract: The hardness and post-scratch surface morphology of Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings subjected to ultrasonic nanocrystal surface modification (UNSM) were examined for detonation-sprayed (DS) and high-velocity oxy-fuel (HVOF) deposits. Four treated samples per deposition route were evaluated at static loads of 20 and 30 N and vibration amplitudes of 20 and 30 µm. Instrumental hardness was measured at a load of 300 mN with a dwell time of 10 s. The DS samples exhibited hardness values of 820–970 HV, whereas the HVOF samples covered the wider range of 546–1165 HV. The highest values were recorded for DS-T1 at 20 N/20 µm and HVOF-T4 at 30 N/30 µm. SEM fields acquired after scratch testing showed heterogeneous surface contrast and crack-like discontinuities in both coating series. These observations provide qualitative evidence of the post-test surface condition but do not isolate damage caused by UNSM or establish a ranking of scratch resistance. Available mean friction coefficients are reported as supplementary observations for six treated samples. The results demonstrate a sample-dependent hardness response and emphasize the need to assess local mechanical properties together with surface integrity.
venue: Journal of Surface Engineering and Coating Technology

zh-Hans.title: 超声纳米晶表面改性后 Cr₃C₂–NiCr 涂层的硬度及划痕后表面形貌
zh-Hans.abstract: 研究了经超声纳米晶表面改性（UNSM）处理的爆炸喷涂（DS）和超音速火焰喷涂（HVOF）Cr₃C₂–NiCr 涂层的硬度及划痕后表面形貌。针对每种沉积工艺，在静载荷为 20 和 30 N、振动振幅为 20 和 30 µm 的条件下，评估了四个处理后样品。在 300 mN 载荷和 10 s 持荷时间下测量仪器化压入硬度。DS 样品的硬度为 820–970 HV，而 HVOF 样品的硬度范围更宽，为 546–1165 HV。DS-T1 在 20 N/20 µm 条件下、HVOF-T4 在 30 N/30 µm 条件下分别获得了各自系列的最高硬度值。划痕试验后获取的 SEM 视场显示，两组涂层均存在不均匀的表面对比度和裂纹状不连续特征。这些观察结果为试验后的表面状态提供了定性证据，但无法单独辨识由 UNSM 引起的损伤，也无法确定耐划伤性能的排序。六个处理后样品的可用平均摩擦系数作为补充观察结果予以报告。结果表明，硬度响应因样品而异，并强调了将局部力学性能与表面完整性相结合进行评估的必要性。

infographic.key_insight: 经 UNSM 处理的 Cr₃C₂–NiCr 涂层的硬度因样品而异，爆炸喷涂涂层和 HVOF 涂层分别在不同的处理参数下获得最高硬度值。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 涂层工艺选择和 UNSM 参数应结合局部硬度与表面完整性进行评估，而不应仅依据硬度。
method: 针对爆炸喷涂和 HVOF 两种沉积工艺，分别评估了四个经 UNSM 处理的样品。
施加 20 或 30 N 的静载荷，以及 20 或 30 µm 的振动振幅。
在 300 mN 载荷和 10 s 持荷时间下测量仪器化压入硬度，并通过 SEM 检查划痕后的表面。
infographic.evidence_signal: 爆炸喷涂涂层的硬度范围为 820–970 HV，HVOF 涂层为 546–1165 HV，二者分别在 20 N/20 µm 和 30 N/30 µm 条件下达到最高值。
infographic.watch_item: 划痕后的 SEM 观察无法单独辨识 UNSM 引起的损伤，也无法确定耐划伤性能的排序。

title: STUDY OF TRIBOLOGICAL PROPERTIES OF BIOCOATINGS BY DETONATION SPRAYING METHOD
authors: Жұлдыз Болатқызы Сағдолдина, Daryn Baizhan, Temirlan Alimbekuly, Akbar S. Alibekov
abstract: In this study, bioactive hydroxyapatite coatings were deposited on commercially pure Grade 2 titanium substrates by detonation spraying at different O₂/C₂H₂ ratios in the range of 2.6-3.7. X-ray diffraction analysis confirmed the predominance of the hydroxyapatite phase with partial formation of α-tricalcium phosphate, which is attributed to high temperatures and intense dynamic processes in the detonation jet. The formed coatings exhibit pronounced hydrophobicity, high structural heterogeneity, and a well-developed surface microrelief, promoting improved interaction with bone tissue and accelerated osseointegration. Tribological tests conducted under dry conditions and in Ringer’s solution demonstrated a significant increase in wear resistance compared to uncoated Grade 2 titanium. The best friction characteristics and the lowest wear volume were observed for coatings deposited at O₂/C₂H₂ ratios of 3.0 and 3.3, which is associated with an optimal combination of crystallinity, phase composition, and adhesion strength. Coatings formed under these conditions provide stable tribological behavior in physiological environments. The obtained results confirm the prospects of detonation-sprayed hydroxyapatite for improving the durability, biocompatibility, and operational reliability of titanium implants.
venue: Bulletin of Shakarim University Technical Sciences

infographic.key_insight: Detonation-sprayed hydroxyapatite coatings improved titanium wear resistance, with the best friction and wear performance at O₂/C₂H₂ ratios of 3.0 and 3.3.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Optimizing the spray gas ratio could improve the durability of titanium implants operating in physiological environments.
method: Deposit hydroxyapatite on Grade 2 titanium at O₂/C₂H₂ ratios of 2.6–3.7.
Use X-ray diffraction to identify coating phases.
Evaluate friction and wear under dry conditions and in Ringer’s solution.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports predominantly hydroxyapatite with partial α-tricalcium phosphate formation and higher wear resistance than uncoated titanium, but provides no numerical wear results.
infographic.watch_item: Improved osseointegration and long-term implant reliability require biological and durability validation beyond the reported tribological tests.

zh-Hans.title: 爆炸喷涂法制备生物涂层的摩擦学性能研究
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究采用爆炸喷涂法，在2.6–3.7范围内的不同O₂/C₂H₂比值下，将生物活性羟基磷灰石涂层沉积于商用纯Grade 2钛基体上。X射线衍射分析证实，涂层以羟基磷灰石相为主，并形成了部分α-磷酸三钙，这归因于爆炸射流中的高温和强烈动态过程。所形成的涂层表现出显著的疏水性、高度的结构非均匀性和发育充分的表面微观起伏，有助于改善与骨组织的相互作用并加速骨整合。在干燥条件和林格氏液中进行的摩擦学试验表明，与未涂覆的Grade 2钛相比，涂层的耐磨性显著提高。在O₂/C₂H₂比值为3.0和3.3时沉积的涂层表现出最佳的摩擦特性和最低的磨损体积，这与结晶度、相组成和结合强度的优化组合有关。在这些条件下形成的涂层在生理环境中具有稳定的摩擦学行为。所得结果证实，爆炸喷涂羟基磷灰石在提高钛植入物的耐久性、生物相容性和使用可靠性方面具有应用前景。

infographic.key_insight: 爆炸喷涂羟基磷灰石涂层提高了钛的耐磨性，其中O₂/C₂H₂比值为3.0和3.3时的摩擦和磨损性能最佳。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 优化喷涂气体比值可能提高在生理环境中服役的钛植入物的耐久性。
method: 在O₂/C₂H₂比值为2.6–3.7的条件下，将羟基磷灰石沉积于Grade 2钛上。
使用X射线衍射鉴定涂层物相。
在干燥条件和林格氏液中评价摩擦与磨损性能。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告，涂层以羟基磷灰石为主，并形成了部分α-磷酸三钙，且耐磨性高于未涂覆的钛，但未提供磨损结果的具体数值。
infographic.watch_item: 骨整合的改善和植入物的长期可靠性仍需在所报告的摩擦学试验之外，进一步开展生物学和耐久性验证。

title: Synthesis of Amorphous and Crystalline Silicon Dioxide Powder Composites from Rice Husk Ash for Thermal Spray Deposit
authors: Daryn Baizhan, Temirlan Alimbekuly, Akbar S. Alibekov, Elzhan Birzhan, G.S. Bektasova, Жұлдыз Болатқызы Сағдолдина
abstract: This paper presents the synthesis of silicon dioxide (SiO₂) from rice husk ash through chemical treatment followed by heat treatment at 800 °C for 3 h. The structural and physicochemical properties of the synthesized silica were investigated using X-ray diffraction (XRD), Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR), and laser diffraction particle size analysis. The synthesized silica exhibited an amorphous structure, with a median particle size (D50) of approximately 88.9 μm. Subsequent annealing at 1200 °C led to crystallization of the silica, resulting in the formation of quartz and cristobalite phases. FTIR analysis revealed characteristic absorption bands associated with Si–O–Si stretching vibrations in the 1000–1100 cm⁻¹ region, as well as bands attributed to hydroxyl groups. The obtained crystalline silica materials demonstrate potential for use as powder materials in thermal spraying technologies.
venue: Bulletin of the Karaganda University Physics Series

infographic.key_insight: Rice husk ash yielded amorphous SiO₂ after chemical treatment and heating at 800 °C for 3 h, then crystallized into quartz and cristobalite upon annealing at 1200 °C.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The resulting silica powders offer a potential agricultural-waste-derived feedstock for thermal spray coatings.
method: Chemically treat rice husk ash, then heat at 800 °C for 3 h.
Anneal at 1200 °C to produce crystalline silica phases.
Characterize structure, bonding, and particle size using XRD, FTIR, and laser diffraction.
infographic.evidence_signal: Characterization identified amorphous silica with D50 ≈ 88.9 µm, quartz and cristobalite after annealing, and Si–O–Si absorption bands at 1000–1100 cm⁻¹.
infographic.watch_item: The abstract reports powder characterization but no thermal spray trials or coating-performance validation.

zh-Hans.title: 由稻壳灰合成用于热喷涂沉积的非晶态与晶态二氧化硅粉末复合材料
zh-Hans.abstract: 本文介绍了通过化学处理并随后在800 °C下热处理3 h，由稻壳灰合成二氧化硅（SiO₂）的方法。采用X射线衍射（XRD）、傅里叶变换红外光谱（FTIR）和激光衍射粒度分析，研究了所合成二氧化硅的结构及物理化学性质。合成的二氧化硅呈非晶态结构，中位粒径（D50）约为88.9 μm。随后在1200 °C下退火使二氧化硅结晶，形成石英相和方石英相。FTIR分析显示，在1000–1100 cm⁻¹区域存在与Si–O–Si伸缩振动相关的特征吸收带，以及归属于羟基的吸收带。所得晶态二氧化硅材料显示出用作热喷涂技术中粉末材料的潜力。

infographic.key_insight: 稻壳灰经化学处理并在800 °C下加热3 h后得到非晶态SiO₂，随后在1200 °C下退火时结晶为石英和方石英。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 所得二氧化硅粉末有望成为一种源自农业废弃物的热喷涂涂层原料。
method: 对稻壳灰进行化学处理，然后在800 °C下加热3 h。
在1200 °C下退火，生成晶态二氧化硅相。
采用XRD、FTIR和激光衍射法表征结构、化学键和粒径。
infographic.evidence_signal: 表征结果确认了D50 ≈ 88.9 µm的非晶态二氧化硅、退火后形成的石英和方石英，以及位于1000–1100 cm⁻¹的Si–O–Si吸收带。
infographic.watch_item: 摘要报告了粉末表征结果，但未报告热喷涂试验或涂层性能验证。
